title: 198章 妖祸再临人世间197章 为何越玩越真实
lines: 想到这里，张荼便是遏制不住的兴奋，待到那时，全球演武之时，就是他带领琅琊六合卫马踏瀛洲之日。
去特么多元民族文化的共存共荣。
除去那一片片零星的斑驳战场，木源城坐落的地方却是大多秀丽多姿，尽显灵气神韵，偶尔突起的一座座巨山，云雾缥缈，犹如仙山坠落人间，纵横交织的河流，虽说没有夷水那么宽阔，但是依旧水系发达，奔腾咆哮，犹如玉龙盘绕。一望无际的远古丛林，更是广袤无垠，生机勃勃。
整个木源城周围，宛如朦胧天图一般，大好河山，如诗如画，壮丽多姿，这般波澜壮阔的天地江山，有什么理由不去守护，护出一个国泰民安！
待到落日时分，张荼和子矜重新回到木源城之中，恍惚间看到前方的巨大的木质城墙，张荼倍感亲切，这边是修行一生，自己征战两世的意义所在。
如今的时代，信息高度的透明化，国家将全部信息尽可能地公布给民众，没有丝毫的藏私，或许是扈渎城的前车之鉴，所有的屏蔽设备被有心之人毫不犹豫地全部销毁，不是说为了求援，至少城破之时，可以给自己至亲至爱的人进行一场完整的告别。
毕竟比死亡还要难以接受的，是不告而别。
哪怕是妖祸即将到来，城中依旧是车水马龙，叫卖声欢闹声不绝于耳，人流往来川流不息，一如既往地热闹。
或许只有看破了苦难的真面目，依旧热爱生活，才是真正的人间烟火气。
张荼带着子矜径直走向了一家常去的酒楼，在二楼选择一个靠窗的位子坐下，吃饭的同时等待着秦风的到来，顺便听着在座的众人谈论着各种最新的信息。
信息需要渠道，如今的时代，还有什么比这种最质朴的渠道来得更真实呢。因为这些都关乎自己的生死，每个人都是异常的认真和重视。
而且这酒楼的老板，也是一个有趣的人，本身便是一个极具实力的大厨，在天地异变之后，更是致力于复刻一些古方古法，用大家比较认同的说法就是这个老板是一个有情怀的人，内心深处，或许有一个江湖梦吧。
“如今已经倒计时了，不知道这一次之后，木源城是否还能够存在。”
“难咯。我看到只有一个中队的护国军驻扎，重武器更是一个都没有。而且修士只有两名b级修士，a级一个都没有。”
“也无妨啊，我们木源城如今也是有着两名a级强者坐镇，若是依旧擂台战，我们未必会输。”
“哪有那么简单，如今的两名a级强者，陈姝君不过是堪堪突破，而陈林虽说是浸淫有一定时间了，但是上一次的湛蓝擂台之上更是深受重伤，如今伤势如何尚且不得而知，如此看来，木源城真的很危险。”
“既然危险，兄弟为何还端坐在这木源城之中？”
“笑话，我张浩生于此长于此，除了这里，我又能到哪里去？怎么说我也是堂堂b级战士，妻儿尽皆死于妖族之手，如今妖族兵临城下，我不杀上几头，怎么对得起我妻儿的在天之灵？”
“张兄别动气，今日还在这里吃喝的兄弟，哪一个不是在这木源城中再无牵挂之人？有张兄等人一起踏足战场，是在下的荣幸！哪怕妖族最终破了这木源城，我等也要他崩下几颗牙！大不了申请繁星落，直接来他个玉石俱焚！”
“就是，怕什么？人死鸟朝上，不死万万年。干了这碗酒，你我同去同归！”
“其实很羡慕琅琊城啊，还有像是京师，建邺，咸阳等地，尽皆有盖世强者坐镇，甚至一个人可以杀穿湛蓝擂台的狠人都不止一个，甚至有能突破的都不突破，压制着境界，放弃修为进境，研磨战技，就是为了保卫一方。”
“羡慕下来，一些城市的底蕴实在是太深了，名动数千年的古城，又岂是我们这般史书都不过寥寥数语的边陲小城可以比拟的？”
“不过琅琊城却是不用羡慕，虽然强者众多，但是竟是没有地脉守护，只能凭借一干强者强行守护，也多亏了张荼是一个大胸怀，得到了天大的造化，竟然直接公开，据说如今的琅琊城已经形成了体系的培养，根据每个人的资质进行量身打造专门的成长计划，极大地提高了未来成为强者的可能性。”
“你们怕不是忘记了，琅琊城在上一波妖祸之中所暴露出来的制式盔甲和长刀，已经让太多人艳羡了好么。而且也是暴露了琅琊城是拥有至少一个宗门的完整传承，真的，当琅琊城暴露得越多，就是愈加的佩服张荼，竟是舍得直接将全部家底托付于自己的兄弟。”
“人比人，气死人，我把我兄弟都快打死了，他也不承认他得到了一个宗门的传承。就张承影等人，一开始的修为并不高，而是在突然被张荼召唤闭关之后，一飞冲天，一跃成为当时顶尖序列，你敢信，这般造化一掏出来，就是五个。”
content_en:
Thinking of this, Zhang Tu couldn't contain his excitement. By then, when the global martial arts show was held, it would be the day when he led the Langya Liuhe Guard Horse to Yingzhou.
Go to the coexistence and common prosperity of diverse ethnic cultures.
Except for the sporadic mottled battlefields, the place where Muyuan City is located is mostly beautiful and colorful, full of aura and charm. Occasionally, huge mountains protrude with misty clouds, like fairy mountains falling into the world. The criss-crossing rivers, although not as wide as Yi Shui, are still well-developed and roaring like jade dragons. The endless ancient jungle is even more vast and full of vitality.
The entire Muyuan City is like a hazy sky map, with great rivers and mountains, poetic and picturesque, magnificent and colorful. What reason is there not to protect such a majestic heaven and earth, and protect a peaceful country and a peaceful people!
When the sun set, Zhang Tu and Zijin returned to Muyuan City. They saw the huge wooden city wall in front of them in a trance. Zhang Tu felt very friendly. This was the meaning of practicing life and fighting for two lives.
In today's era, information is highly transparent. The state discloses all information to the public as much as possible without hiding any secrets. Perhaps it is a lesson for Hudu City. All shielding equipment was destroyed without hesitation by those who were interested. It was not to ask for help. At least when the city was destroyed, they could give a complete farewell to their nearest and dearest.
After all, what is more difficult to accept than death is to say goodbye without saying goodbye.
Even if a demonic disaster is about to come, the city is still bustling with traffic, the sounds of hawkers and merriment are endless, and the flow of people is endless, and it is as lively as ever.
Perhaps only by seeing through the true face of suffering and still loving life can the real fireworks in the world be achieved.
Zhang Tu took Zi Jin straight to a restaurant he frequented, and chose a seat by the window on the second floor to sit down. While eating, he waited for Qin Feng's arrival and listened to everyone present talking about the latest information.
Information needs channels, and in today's era, what could be more true than this simplest channel. Because these are related to one's own life and death, everyone takes them extremely seriously and seriously.
Moreover, the owner of this restaurant is also an interesting person. He is a very capable chef himself. After the sudden change in the world, he is committed to replicating some ancient methods. To use a more generally accepted saying, this owner is a person with feelings. Deep down in his heart, he may have a dream of becoming a martial artist.
"The countdown has begun. I don't know if Muyuan City can still exist after this time."
"It's difficult. I saw that there is only one squadron of the National Protector Army stationed there, and there are no heavy weapons. And there are only two B-level monks and none of the A-level monks."
"It doesn't matter. We in Muyuan City now have two A-level experts in charge. If we continue to fight in the arena, we may not lose."
"It's not that simple. Of the two A-level experts today, Chen Shujun is just a breakthrough, and although Chen Lin has been immersed in it for a certain period of time, he was seriously injured on the Azure Arena last time. The extent of the injury is still unknown. From this point of view, Muyuan City is really in danger."
"Since it's dangerous, why are you still sitting here in Muyuan City?"
"It's a joke. I, Zhang Hao, was born and raised here. Where else can I go but here? After all, I am also a B-level warrior. My wife and children all died at the hands of the demon clan. Now that the demon clan is approaching the city, if I don't kill a few of them, how can I be worthy of my wife and children's souls in heaven?"
"Brother Zhang, don't be angry. Which of the brothers who are still eating and drinking here today is not someone who has nothing to worry about in this Muyuan City? It is an honor for me to have Brother Zhang and others set foot on the battlefield together! Even if the demon clan finally breaks this Muyuan City, we will make him lose a few teeth! At worst, if he applies for Starfall, he will die directly!"
"That's right, what are you afraid of? If a person dies and a bird looks up, he will not die for eternity. After drinking this bowl of wine, you and I will go together and return together!"
"Do it!"
"Actually, I'm very envious of Langya City. There are places like the Capital, Jianye, Xianyang, etc., all of which have unparalleled powerful men. There are even more than one ruthless person who can kill through the azure arena. There are even those who can break through but don't break through. They suppress the realm, give up their cultivation to enter the realm, and hone their combat skills, just to defend one side."
"I'm envious. The heritage of some cities is really too deep. How can an ancient city that has been famous for thousands of years be compared to a small border town like ours with only a few words in the history book?"
"However, there is no need to envy Langya City. Although there are many powerful people, there is no earth line protection. They can only rely on a group of strong people to protect it. Thanks to Zhang Tu, who has a big heart and has been blessed by heaven, he directly made it public. It is said that Langya City has now formed a system of training. A special growth plan is tailor-made according to each person's qualifications, which greatly improves the possibility of becoming a strong person in the future."
"I'm afraid you have forgotten that the standard armor and long swords exposed in Langya City during the last wave of demon disasters have already made too many people envious. It also exposed that Langya City has a complete inheritance of at least one sect. Really, the more Langya City is exposed, the more I admire Zhang Tu, who is willing to directly entrust his entire family wealth to his brother."
"Comparing people with each other makes people mad. I almost beat my brother to death, and he didn't admit that he had received the inheritance of a sect. Zhang Chengying and others did not have high cultivation levels at the beginning, but after being suddenly summoned by Zhang Tu to retreat, they soared into the sky and became the top rank at that time. Can you believe that when you take out such a fortune, there are five."
title_en: Chapter 198: The demonic disaster returns to the world Chapter 197: Why the more you play, the more real it becomes
